verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a v3 REST Web API, but the evidence only shows it covering mail send (plus a sandbox validation parameter). Domain authentication, dynamic templates and Deliverability Insights appear only in UI docs, and Insights is described as an in-app dashboard, so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: any documented statement of API/UI parity, API coverage for domain authentication, template management, analytics/insights, account and settings management, and independent confirmation of programmatic coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale
The Mail Send operation allows you to send email over SendGrid's v3 Web API
